description: Finds the site where robot bot-A reported its lowest battery in one long sample file, with tied samples broken by the earliest timestamp and a look-alike robot that ran lower. DISTILL-CANARY-24cd9cef

files.fleet/README.md:
# Fleet battery samples

battery.txt holds every sample of the week, semicolon separated: ts;device;battery_pct;site;fw, first line is the header. Rows are not sorted by time.
Device ids are whole values: `bot-AB` is a different robot from `bot-A`.
When several samples share the lowest battery level, use the one with the earliest ts.

turns.prompt: In fleet/battery.txt, at which site was bot-A when it reported its lowest battery level? fleet/README.md explains how to break ties; reply with the site name and the total number of bot-A samples.
